scope: tcConnect finite payload response/body wait and timeout recovery
assessment: Promise.race bounds the complete payload fetch and JSON body operation to 8000 ms. Timeout marks payloadExpired before abort, and the completion-time guard independently rejects elapsed or backward-clock completion.

The losing response operation only returns response/body data. Late resolution or rejection has no SDK calls, recipient mutation, status write, or preparation release; Promise.race installs rejection handling on both participants.

Current-only timeout feedback offers an explicit new connection or manual address. Outer finally clears the timer, clears unhanded request parameters and releases the preparation/button; payload timeout does not quarantine the SDK.
Identity and recipient-state checks remain before any payload is accepted or SDK handoff begins. Late old payload work cannot own or release a subsequent explicit preparation.
Only tcConnect changes. Existing SDK wait quarantine, callback guard, verification, BUY/SELL confirmation and backend paths are unchanged.

Read-only preflight validates 58 live input hashes, four unchanged service states, target metadata and exact substituted public response against deployed SDK-wait baseline 0a596242b6b51783cf117a0848935eda7dbadb14d136f2558b05d8c607f47f76.
Eighteen local scope/drift/apply/reconcile/exact rollback checks passed. Temporary-directory rehearsal preserved metadata and unrelated inputs; production not mutated.
limitations: AbortController requests cancellation but cannot guarantee it; correctness relies on the raced losing operation being data-only and on preparation identity checks.
This slice addresses payload preparation waiting; other E4 prerequisites and business acceptance remain outside this review.
